title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 19:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 341 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)

A few modest active regions and small sunspots are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no obvious large outward feature.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
